The '''DL-6H heavy blaster pistol''' was a model of heavy blaster pistol produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] during the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Because of its relatively small size and high power output, the DL-6H was outlawed in many star systems. The [[Pirate]] [[Captain]] [[Venslas Beeli]] used a pair of these weapons.
